policy.scope: Only the exact-image, numeric UID 10001, read-only VideoQ vLLM serving workloads rendered from the reviewed NVIDIA profiles; not a blanket upstream image approval. No image changes, installer operations, arbitrary hooks, downloaded Python model code or host-kernel claims. Includes the reviewed RTX 4090 profiles, their fixed memory fractions and eager configuration; site overrides still require review. Native video/Mooncake directories are masked by verified empty read-only mounts; the audio overlay includes a manifest-hashed local-input startup guard. Also includes the pinned Gemma 4 BF16 / EmbeddingGemma 2 / Whisper profile with gemma4 parsers, thinking disabled and bounded image input. This extension reviews command/filesystem applicability only; it does not attest GPU execution or model quality. Includes the RTX 4090 Gemma 4 BF16 command with 40 GiB CPU weight offload, eager execution, disabled processor cache and bounded multimodal input; GPU capacity and performance remain unverified.

runtimeDistinction.linuxLibcDev: 75 findings identify the development UAPI/header package through dpkg metadata; they are not proof that a vulnerable kernel is running inside the container or host. Per-CVE affected program files and exact native inventory must be reviewed before any scoped non-applicability conclusion.
runtimeDistinction.baseFfmpeg: 11 findings identify actual shared libraries in PyNvVideoCodec; existing verified empty read-only directory masks may exclude these libraries only within the exact rendered serving workload. An installed-package scan remains true and cannot be waived for arbitrary image use.
runtimeDistinction.audioFfmpeg: 11 findings identify actual shared libraries in the mounted PyAV audio overlay. Decoder allowlisting alone does not establish exclusion of audio/video filters, filter commands, encoders or network protocols. In particular dynaudnorm and azmq require exact call-path evidence.

correctiveOptions.requirements: Find independently verified upstream immutable image and exact audio wheel artifacts whose bundled FFmpeg fixes all relevant findings; preserve ABI/model/codec compatibility, provenance and full native runtime/inventory/scans. No replacement artifact is authorized by this report.

For all 75 header findings compare primary affected program files against exact UAPI inventory; for each of 11 FFmpeg CVEs review primary conditions against actual masks and no-filter/no-command/codec paths, then retain existing real native probes and refreshed full scans.
